fields.name: remaining_target_positions
fields.description: For goals requesting multiple container pickups, an ordered list of the original cube positions for requested container pickups not yet completed, in goal order. Initialize from the visible cubes at the first decision step, including only requested colors. For a single-pickup goal, write [] at every decision step: recover the target from the pre-covering frames and covering event in the pickup decision's observation instead. Retain the original coordinates despite pixel wobble or subsequent covering. Remove the first entry at the decision step showing that its container has actually been grasped and lifted, not at the step selecting the pickup. Putting a container back does not restore its entry. Thus episode 71 has [[92, 93], [128, 118]] at steps 1 and 2 and [[128, 118]] at steps 3 and 4. Single-pickup episodes instead have [] throughout. e.g. [[92, 93], [128, 118]]
